_comment: The quality levels' table (render-arch ST3.3 / ST3.4; docs/design/ST3_Scalability_Groups_Plan.md sec.2.2 / 8.2).
Each group's level is a player setting, scalability.<group> (Low, Medium, High, Ultra, Cinematic);
these are the player rows it sets and their value at each level, in that order. A level's values
are the settings store's Scalability layer: the player's own value for a row sits over it.
Checked at load (Settings/Scalability.h): a player row, in one group, not the lighting tier's
(renderPath, rtReflections, rtShadows, rtao, ddgi), not LastWrite; five values the row takes as
they are; High = the row's default. One bad entry refuses the table - the levels then set nothing.
